gloss: inside the building; within the facility

definitions.gloss: inside the building; within the facility
definitions.explanation: The interior of a large building such as a museum, hotel, library, or theater. Often used in signs and announcements.

examples.japanese: {館内|かんない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧です。
examples.english: Smoking is prohibited inside the building.

examples.japanese: {館内|かんない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案内図|あんないず}→案内図：17781_annaizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please look at the floor map of the building.

examples.japanese: {館内|かんない}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、ご⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be advised that eating and drinking are not permitted inside the building.

notes:
Refers to the interior of a ⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧-type building — museums, libraries, hotels, theaters, sports arenas, etc. Very commonly seen on signs and in announcements at public facilities.
